The bowl looks like a metal mixing bowl about 20-22 cm across at the rim, and it holds a pile of diced cooked chicken along with shredded carrot, cherry tomatoes and red onion.

**Chicken:** The pile is about 12 cm across and several centimeters deep. I estimate roughly 200 g of chicken. Grilled chicken breast is about 1.65 kcal/g, so that is about 330 kcal.

**Vegetables:** The carrot is about 30 g (about 12 kcal). There are about 6 cherry tomatoes at roughly 15 g each, so about 90 g (about 16 kcal). The red onion is about 15 g (about 6 kcal). Together the vegetables come to about 135 g and 35 kcal.

**Total:** About 335 g of food and about 365 kcal. I don't see any visible oil or sauce.
